description: Multi-model AI agent runtime. Define agents in YAML, route each role to a model, orchestrate with 7 patterns (ReAct, Plan & Execute, Fan-Out, Pipeline, Supervisor, Swarm, Glyph), and deploy as a REST/WebSocket API with RAG, memory, MCP tools, guardrails and OpenTelemetry observability.
